cloud-platform-engineer-stuttgart-174177,IP Dynamics GmbH,Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d),"
Ab

sofort


Das erwartet dich

Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management.

Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert.

Das erwartet dich

Plattform entwickeln und gestalten

  • Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle)
  • Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung
  • Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle
  • Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept
  • Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt
Automatisieren und standardisieren
  • GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert
  • Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools
column2:
Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance
  • CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse
    • Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden
    • Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings
    • Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform
    • Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance


    Das bringst du mit

    Must-have

    • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung
    • Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen
    • Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform)
    • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
    • Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten
    Nice-to-have
    • Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen
    • Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten
    • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana)
    Persönlich
    • Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild
    • Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden
    • Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
    • Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern


    Was wir dir bieten

    • Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen.
    • Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt.
    • Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.
    • Genieße Benefits wie BusinessBike, EGYM Wellpass, Corporate Benefits und einen Zuschuss für den ÖPNV.
    • Neben einem VWL-Zuschuss bieten wir dir eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine Kita-Förderung.
    • Ob Surfen, Wandern, Mountainbiken oder Golfen – bei unseren vielseitigen Mitarbeiter-Events ist für jeden etwas dabei!

Your role

About FRASER 

FRASER is an independent creative agency with teams across Berlin, Zurich, Cape Town and Dubai. We develop integrated campaigns, content and digital experiences for ambitious international brands, combining strategic thinking, creativity and technology. As we continue to grow, we're building scalable operations to support our international business. 

 Your role 

  • Take ownership of the finance function across FRASER, ensuring accurate financial reporting and efficient day-to-day financial operations.  
  • Prepare monthly management accounts, budgets, cash flow forecasts and financial analyses to support business decisions.  
  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, payment runs, reconciliations and liquidity planning.  
  • Coordinate the preparation of bookkeeping (Vorbereitende Buchhaltung), ensuring invoices, purchase orders and supporting documentation are complete and accurate before submission to external accounting partners. 
  • Work closely with our external accounting firms in Germany, Switzerland, South Africa and Dubai, ensuring smooth collaboration and timely financial processes. 
  • Coordinate month-end and year-end closing activities together with external accountants and tax advisors.  
  • Ensure compliance with German accounting, tax and statutory requirements while supporting finance processes across our international locations.  
  • Collaborate closely with the Managing Directors and Founder on budgeting, forecasting, profitability and business performance.  
  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting and operational efficiency.  
  • Help build and scale the finance function, with the opportunity to grow into the Head of Finance role as the company continues to expand. 


Your profile


  • Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.  
  • 5+ years of experience in finance, accounting, controlling or financial management.  
  • Strong understanding of German accounting, bookkeeping and financial regulations.  
  • Experience with vorbereitender Buchhaltung, including invoice verification, purchase order management and coordination with external accountants.  
  • Previous experience within a creative agency, marketing agency or professional services environment is a strong advantage.  
  • Experience working with multiple international entities is a plus. 
  • Excellent organisational skills and a structured, hands-on approach.  
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.  
  • DATEV experience is an advantage.  
  • Advanced Excel skills.  
  • Fluent English is essential. German should be at least professional working proficiency, with a solid understanding of German accounting terminology.  
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and international environment.

  • The opportunity to shape a globally relevant social media arm of a growing agency with relevant big clients and substantial business 
  • A senior leadership team that is close and passionately ambitious

  • Opportunity for workation from European countries or South Africa 
  • Flexible working hours and locations, including 3 days on site in our great office and 2 home office 
  • A great roof terrace in the heart of Kreuzberg and always a fridge full of cool drinks 

We are an equal opportunity employer. This role, like all at FRASER, is open to talent regardless of age, creed, gender, or race. We hire for ability and skill. And we look forward to getting to know you.

Unsere Unternehmenssprache sowie die Kommunikation mit unseren Hochschulkunden erfolgen vollständig auf Deutsch. Daher setzen wir für diese Position Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau voraus.

  • Sinn und Wirkung: Mit unserer Software gestalten wir die Bildung von morgen und übernehmen Verantwortung – auch über den Job hinaus, z. B. im Rahmen unserer Social Days.

Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen.   • Architektur &
column2:

column3:

Kurzbeschreibung

Du bringst Projekte sicher ins Ziel und gibst Kund:innen das Gefühl, in guten Händen zu sein?
Du kannst Performance-Daten analysieren, Creative-Ergebnisse einordnen und daraus klare strategische Empfehlungen ableiten?
Du kommunizierst klar, führst souverän durch Abstimmungen und behältst den roten Faden?

Dann suchen wir dich als (Senior) Account Manager (m/w/d) für unser adfriends-Team!*

*adfriends ist Teil der Friendventure-Gruppe


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst deine Kunden eigenverantwortlich und bist ihre zentrale Ansprechperson im Projektalltag
  • Deine Stärke liegt darin, Ziele und Anforderungen in klare Briefings, Timings und Next Steps zu übersetzen
  • Du planst und steuerst Social- und Advertising-Kampagnen von Kick-off bis Auswertung und Optimierung
  • Du ordnest Performance-Ergebnisse strategisch ein und leitest Handlungsempfehlungen ab
  • Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kreation, Performance/Media Buying und ggf. externen Partnern und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe
  • Budget, Aufwand, Ressourcen und Prioritäten hast du jederzeit im Blick – ohne dass Qualität oder Tempo leiden
  • Auch im New Business packst du mit an: Du sprichst passende Unternehmen an, führst Erstgespräche, qualifizierst Anfragen und begleitest bis zum Angebot


Dein Profil

Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.


Who we’re looking for

Craft is the baseline here, not a nice-to-have. What sets you apart is range and judgment: you know what good looks like, you know when something looks right but feels wrong, and you can get a team there with you.

  • Fluency in English (C1+) is required. German (C1) is a plus, but not a must-have.
  • Genuine design craft with a track record: you've shipped interfaces real users navigated without explanation, and you can point to the metric that moved.
  • Strong visual sensibility, high standards, and an eye for detail.
  • Range across Design, Product, and Engineering: you've gone from user problem to testable prototype without waiting for a brief, and used AI coding tools to build something real. You're not dependent on an engineer to realize your vision.
  • You've built personal AI workflows that make you meaningfully faster, and you know when to trust, edit, or reject AI output.
  • Comfortable in ambiguity: you ship, collect signal, and iterate rather than waiting for full clarity.
  • You are excited to show your work (portfolio or examples).
  • Ideally you've worked on products where getting it wrong has real consequences (fintech, healthtech, logistics, compliance), but that's not a must-have.
  • Berlin-based or willing to relocate.
This role is not for you if…
  • You want a PM to define the problem and an engineer to implement the solution.
  • You resist working in code or with AI.
  • You hand off polished Figma files and believe your job is done.
  • You judge yourself on taste alone, not outcomes.

At Impower GmbH, we are shaping the future of property management — simple, fast, and digital. More than 100,000 people manage over 12 million apartments using processes that are still largely manual, complex, and time-consuming. We are changing that with modern technology, clear workflows, and real practical value.


Our Cloud ERP brings complex processes such as accounting, banking, and property management into one intuitive platform. As our product continues to grow, great design plays a key role in turning this complexity into simple and efficient user experiences.


As a Senior Product Designer, you take ownership of key areas of our core product and shape experiences that property managers rely on every day. Working closely with our Head of Design, Product Owners, and Engineers, you turn complex workflows into intuitive solutions and drive design topics hands-on from the initial problem to the shipped feature.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Own and drive product design across key areas of our core platform, from problem discovery to final implementation
  • Translate complex, data-heavy workflows into simple, intuitive, and scalable user experiences
  • Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-quality UI designs that clearly communicate your solutions
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn concepts into technically feasible, shippable features
  • Contribute to and continuously improve our design system, including reusable components, patterns, and documentation
  • Use customer insights, product context, and feedback to challenge assumptions and continuously improve existing experiences
  • Support other designers by sharing expertise, providing feedback, and helping strengthen design quality across the team

  • You have experience designing complex, data-heavy products such as ERP systems, business software, or comparable applications
  • You combine strong UX thinking with excellent UI skills and experience working with scalable design systems
  • You are highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using modern AI and prototyping tools to accelerate your design process
  • You understand front-end development constraints and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers to bring designs into production
  • You take ownership of complex problems and confidently drive them from initial exploration through to a high-quality solution
  • You communicate confidently in both German and English and enjoy working in an international, cross-functional environment

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey
column2:
every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an ""ownership mindset"" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

column3: The Director of Product Marketing and Market Research is a combined senior leadership role responsible for two things that should never have been separated: how Mews brings products to market, and how Mews understands the market it operates in. You will lead the product marketing team, own the research and customer insights function, and serve as the go-to authority on both disciplines for senior leadership across the business.&lt

Mews operates across property management, fintech and payments, guest experience, and marketplace. The right person for this role knows how to build a coherent positioning story across a complex multi-product portfolio – and how to ground that story in real market intelligence, customer insight, and competitive understanding rather than assumption.&lt
Define and own product marketing strategy across the Mews portfolio – covering positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution from launch through adoption and ongoing engagement.&lt
Build and govern the global product launch framework so that launches are scalable and repeatable, with clear handoffs between strategy and execution.&lt
Own product adoption and post-launch engagement strategy – moving the function beyond launch execution to continuous market thinking that drives usage, retention, and revenue contribution.&lt
Partner with Product, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Success to ensure product marketing strategy connects to commercial outcomes and is reflected in how the business goes to market.&lt
Own NPS tracking programs and design the measurement framework for product marketing impact, including product attach rates, adoption metrics, and pipeline contribution.&lt
Own the end-to-end market research function: identifying research opportunities, designing methodology, running studies, synthesising findings, and activating insights across the business.&lt

Lead primary and secondary research initiatives that inform strategic, commercial, and product decisions – including competitive analysis, customer behaviour, market sizing, and buyer intelligence.&lt
Build competitive intelligence as a structured, ongoing discipline – not a one-off project. Translate competitive signals into positioning decisions, sales enablement, and product roadmap input.&lt
Serve as the functional authority on what the market is telling Mews, and translate that into insight narratives that influence senior leadership decisions and business strategy.&lt
Work closely with Strategy, Product, RevOps, and Marketing to ensure insights land where decisions get made, not just where they get read.&lt
Lead and develop a team of product marketers, setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a culture of commercial accountability.&lt
Set the operating model for how the team works with AI – determining where AI handles execution tasks and where human judgment is irreplaceable, and building team-level standards accordingly.&lt
Serve as the senior leadership go-to on product marketing and market intelligence – the person any executive can trust for a well-grounded, commercially-connected answer.&lt
Represent product marketing and research in executive forums, contributing to annual planning and portfolio prioritisation decisions.&lt

Proven track record managing and developing a multi-person product marketing team, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.&lt
Experience owning or significantly contributing to a market research or customer insights function – primary research methodology, competitive intelligence programs, or voice-of-customer work.&lt
Deep understanding of B2B SaaS go-to-market strategy: positioning, messaging architecture, pricing and packaging alignment, sales enablement, and lifecycle marketing.&lt
Experience building or significantly reshaping a product marketing function – not just managing an inherited one.&lt

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Partner Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team, focused on building Coder’s partner ecosystem across EMEA. This is a new function at Coder, modeled on the Forward Deployed Engineer role pioneered by companies like Palantir and now the fastest-growing technical role at frontier AI companies. The difference: instead of embedding with a single customer to deploy a platform, you embed with strategic partners to help them understand, position, and deliver Coder’s platform across their entire customer base.

You are part Field CTO, part Industry Strategist, part Technical Specialist, and part Partner Relations Lead. You will be the technical authority within our EMEA partner ecosystem: setting the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI, cloud, and modernization offerings, co-creating the GTM sales plays that partner sellers take to market, building the demonstrations and workshops that generate pipeline, and producing the Partner Relations content that establishes Coder’s technical brand in the ecosystem.

This is not a support role. You are equally comfortable holding a strategic roadmap conversation with a partner CTO and debugging a Kubernetes deployment in a partner’s lab in the same afternoon. You are energized by the challenge of building a new category through partnerships, motivated by the multiplied impact of enabling an entire ecosystem rather than a single customer, and capable of operating with full autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the strategic technical thought partner to EMEA partner leadership, including practice leads, CTOs, and solutions architects at global systems integrators, regional cloud consultancies, and hyperscaler field teams. Own the technical relationship and set the vision for how Coder fits into each partner’s AI and modernization portfolio.

  • Build AI-powered self-service tools that automate high-volume PDE activities: Opportunity Brief Generator, PR/FAQ Generator, Workshop-in-a-Box deployment, and demo site builder.

  • Produce a monthly partner intelligence digest from EMEA engagements: what customers are asking for, how competitors are positioning, where integrations are missing, which vertical use cases are emerging. Distribute to Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.

  • Own the EMEA-relevant portions of the joint technical integration roadmap with strategic partners. Define priorities cross-functionally with Product and Engineering based on field signals from the EMEA market.

  • Create and publish Partner Relations content, the ecosystem equivalent of Developer Relations: technical blog posts, cookbooks, partner ecosystem conference talks, enablement videos, and workshop recaps. Build Coder’s technical brand within the EMEA partner community.

  • Contribute to cloud marketplace product listing stewardship, competency maintenance documentation, and CSP co-build technical requirements as they apply to EMEA-specific partner and compliance contexts.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in a combination of Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Field CTO, Technical Consulting, or Developer Relations roles at an infrastructure, developer tools, or AI company

  • Demonstrated experience helping partners or customers understand and adopt products in emerging or undefined categories, not just executing playbooks for established ones

  • Proven hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure), with production-level Kubernetes and Terraform depth. You have done the work and can speak to it with specificity.

  • 2+ years deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in a European enterprise context

  • Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security, compliance, or data sovereignty stakeholder

  • Experience working with channel or technology partners in a co-sell model: hyperscaler partner programs, GSI/RSI partnerships, or VAR/distributor ecosystems in EMEA markets

  • Experience building repeatable technical GTM assets that scaled beyond your personal delivery: sales plays, enablement curricula, reference architectures, or technical content programs

  • Executive communication and Field CTO credibility: you can hold a technical vision conversation with a partner CTO and a deal-level architecture review with an SE in the same day, in English and ideally at least one additional European language

  • Strong written communication: you can produce a Working Backwards PR/FAQ, a technical architecture document, and a blog post without those being separate skills requiring separate people

  • Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy. You will define processes that don’t exist, build tools that haven’t been scoped, and create a function from first principles in a new region.

Bonus Points

(Bonus tacos? That’s how we say thanks at Coder. Ask us about it.)

  • Prior Forward Deployed Engineer experience at a platform company (Palantir, Scale AI, frontier AI lab, or equivalent embedded deployment model)

  • Track record of public technical advocacy: blog posts, conference talks, open-source contributions, or developer/partner community engagement

  • Experience with hyperscaler partner programs (e.g., ISV Accelerate, strategic collaboration agreements, co-sell programs) at an operational level

  • Experience with air-gapped or network-isolated deployments common in European financial services, government, or defense contexts

  • Background in AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

  • Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

  • Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

  • Open-source contributions, particularly in CNCF, MCP, or AI agent ecosystems

  • Existing relationships with hyperscaler EMEA solutions architecture teams, European GSI technical practices, or AI infrastructure partner ecosystems

  • Fluency in German, French, or a Nordic language in addition to English

  • You have done the hard technical work before: deploying cloud-native infrastructure, navigating Kubernetes in production, building with Terraform, and operating in the complexity of large European enterprise environments. You bring that credibility into every partner conversation.

  • You can walk a partner CTO through how Coder enables parallelized AI agents in a regulated European enterprise, covering credential isolation, audit lineage, GDPR-compliant data handling, and escalation design, and turn that conversation into a joint GTM play their sellers can run next quarter.

  • You can walk into an unstructured partner relationship, assess the technical and commercial opportunity, and chart a path from first enablement session to first co-sourced deal without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You translate deep technical knowledge into assets that scale: reference architectures partners hand to their customers, enablement modules partners consume on their own, and GTM playbooks partner sellers run without PDE involvement.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here.

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

  • Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

  • Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

  • Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

  • Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

  • Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

  • Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

  • Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

  • Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

  • Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

  • Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

column1: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Architect-Anthropic based in France.

As an Agentic AI Architect, you will shape and deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions that combine generative AI, machine learning, data, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation. You will design scalable architectures that connect Claude and other AI technologies with enterprise knowledge, applications, APIs, workflows, and mission-critical systems. The role offers significant technical ownership, from discovery and architecture through deployment, evaluation, governance, and optimization. You will work closely with client stakeholders, consultants, data engineers, AI/ML specialists, and platform teams to turn complex business needs into practical solutions. A strong focus will be placed on agentic workflows, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, responsible AI, and human oversight. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI while helping organizations adopt powerful technologies securely and responsibly. Travel to clients and conferences may be required as needed.
• Architect, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
• Define end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion and preparation, model selection, orchestration, APIs, integrations, user experiences, monitoring, security, and governance.
• Partner with business and technical stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities, translate requirements into technical designs, and establish delivery roadmaps.
• Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, design reviews, proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and solution delivery activities.
• Design and implement LLM-powered applications using Claude, Anthropic APIs, and other appropriate LLM platforms.
• Apply prompt and context engineering techniques, including instruction design, few-shot examples, structured inputs and outputs, response constraints, and long-context management.

• Architect secure RAG solutions using enterprise documents, knowledge bases, databases, and other approved information sources, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, citations, and response generation.
• Build agentic systems capable of reasoning over enterprise context, using authorized tools, executing multi-step tasks, and coordinating workflows across enterprise applications.
• Define agent roles, task boundaries, permissions, memory and context strategies, approval gates, fallback mechanisms, and escalation paths.
• Integrate AI agents and workflows with ServiceNow, enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, collaboration platforms, and operational systems.
• Implement human-in-the-loop controls and safeguards for sensitive, high-impact, low-confidence, or exception-based actions.

Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and ""what should we build?"" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. Your new team:

As an Implementation Specialist, you are right at the heart of our projects: You translate business requirements into robust technical tracking solutions, implement them, ensure their quality, and turn concepts into fully functioning digital analytics setups. You take full responsibility for digital analytics implementations from initial requirements through to go-live and act as a trusted advisor to our clients throughout the process.


What awaits you:

  • You analyze our clients’ requirements and translate business and analytics use cases into technically sound tracking and implementation concepts.
  • You develop and document tracking concepts, data models, and data layer requirements and align them with clients and developers.
  • You work with tag management systems, implement tracking and third-party tags, and ensure scalable data collection.
  • You conduct technical testing, debugging, and data validation and systematically investigate data quality issues.
  • You consider consent management, data protection, and technical requirements from the very beginning of the implementation process.
  • You work closely with Digital Analysts, Data Engineers, and Project Managers, acting as the technical interface between business and development.
  • You actively share your expertise within your team and help develop our standards, best practices, and ways of working.
  • Depending on the project, you may also support tool selection, architecture decisions, migrations, and the technical enablement of our clients.


What you can expect:

At FELD M, you won’t work within a traditional agency structure with rigid specializations. We bring together different disciplines and perspectives and see ourselves as The Data Collective.

You will have the opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients, industries, and technology setups while continuously expanding your expertise. We deliberately work independently of specific tools while bringing many years of expertise and strong partnerships with, among others, Google and Adobe. Our projects range from auditing and optimizing existing implementations to complete new implementations and migrations, as well as complex analytics and data setups.

You also won’t work in isolation: At FELD M, the close connection between business, analytics, and technology is at the core of what we do. This intersection is what makes the role particularly exciting.

What else? We believe in People First and Sustainable Pace. Taking responsibility and delivering high-quality work does not mean constantly operating at full speed. We want to do great work sustainably – together, with mutual support and room for different lifestyles.We are looking for people who are curious, take ownership, and enjoy sharing their expertise. We don’t see job descriptions as rigid checklists. Instead, we want to understand how your experience, interests, and strengths fit the role and what we need as a team.


What you bring along:

  • You don’t need to know every tool. What matters more is that you have a strong understanding of digital analytics and can quickly familiarize yourself with new technologies and setups.
  • Several years of professional experience in digital analytics, web analytics, tracking, or MarTech implementation
  • Strong knowledge of at least one tag management system
  • Experience designing and implementing data layers and tracking concepts
  • A solid understanding of client-side and server-side tracking, as well as their respective technical requirements and capabilities
  • A solid technical understanding of web technologies, particularly JavaScript
  • Experience with testing and data validation of analytics implementations
  • An understanding of consent management, data protection, and the technical implications for tracking
  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders
  • A structured, analytical, and quality-oriented approach to your work
  • A genuine interest in taking ownership and not just analyzing technical challenges, but implementing solutions yourself
We look forward to meeting you!

Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. column2:

column3:

column4:

column5:

  • Technical Routine: You feel ""at home"" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations.

Intro

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d), you play a central role in developing and expanding our existing digital therapy offering. 

You drive forward how we can support patients and physicians even better in treating and reducing musculoskeletal pain. Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success. 

You conceive, validate, and prioritize new product and service ideas and prepare them for implementation in a structured way. Your work lays the foundation for expanding our product and service portfolio, strengthens long-term customer relationships, and creates lasting value – beyond the actual therapy phase.


What you should bring

  • Experience: Several years of solid product management experience (typically 5+ years), e.g. as Senior, Lead, or Principal Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA, or similar fields. You have independently owned a digital product area and can show how your decisions changed user and business outcomes.
  • Outcome-driven product development: You steer by impact, not output – data-driven decisions come naturally to you.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership: You communicate confidently with C-level, Engineering, Regulatory, and the clinical team.
  • Mindset: You bring strong empathy for the medical context, act proactively, and have a solution-oriented, hands-on mentality.
  • AI fluency: You use AI pragmatically in discovery, research, analysis, or prototyping and can judge where it accelerates product work – and where human judgement remains essential.
  • Language: Excellent German and English (C1 or above in both) – neither needs to be your native language.

Nice to have
  • Experience in Healthcare, Digital Health, HealthTech, MedTech, Pharma, Digital Therapeutics, or Clinical Software – ideally with direct DiGA experience and knowledge of the regulatory framework (DiGA, MDR).
  • Experience working with physicians, practice teams, medical assistants, patients, or other healthcare stakeholders.


What to expect at Vivira

  • Workplace: Work from home or from our centrally located Berlin HQ.
  • Working abroad: The option to work remotely for up to one month per year from the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK.

  • Referral bonus: Sharing your network pays off – every successful referral is rewarded.
  • Highlights: Several company and team events per year create exchange, fun, and a real sense of community.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für unseren Standort Berlin einen erfahrenen Senior Elektroingenieur (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Analogelektronik und Messtechnik, der mit seinem Know-how unsere Mess- und Inspektionstechnologie technisch weiter voranbringt.

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. qualitatsmanager-lieferantenqualitat-produktprufung-ganderkesee-394337,Presch Tools GmbH,Qualitätsmanager (m/w/d) - Lieferantenqualität & Produktprüfung,"

Es ist Feierabend und du verlässt das Office, happy und mit einem starken Gefühl. Dein erster Tag bei PRESCH war einfach stark 🔥

Du hast dir das Sortiment angesehen: über 500 aktive Artikel, vom Hammer bis zum Säbelsägeblatt, Lieferanten über halb Asien verteilt, Verkauf in mehr als zwanzig Länder. Und du hast sofort gesehen, wo das System noch fehlt. Nicht weil hier niemand hinschaut — sondern weil bisher niemand die Aufgabe hatte, aus einzelnen Prüfungen eine Systematik zu machen.
Genau das wird deine Aufgabe. Wir erweitern unsere Qualitätssicherung deutlich, weil wir immer mehr eigene Produkte entwickeln. Du bekommst keine fertige Struktur vorgesetzt, du entwirfst sie 💪
Und du merkst schnell: Hier wird nicht geredet, hier wird gemacht. Kurze Wege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen am selben Tag.

🛠️ Du gibst frei — oder eben nicht. Vor jeder Verschiffung kommt ein Muster aus der laufenden Produktion zu dir. Du prüfst nach Maß, Werkstoff, Oberfläche und Funktion, dokumentierst das Ergebnis im Erstmusterprüfbericht und entscheidest, ob die Ware rausgeht. Ohne dein Ja bewegt sich nichts.

🛠️ Du baust die Prüfsystematik auf. Prüfvorschriften je Warengruppe und je Artikel, Stichprobenumfang und Annahmezahlen nach AQL, Freigabemuster als verbindlicher Vergleichsmaßstab, Rückverfolgbarkeit von jedem Befund zu Charge und Lieferant. Reproduzierbarkeit ist der Anspruch: Dieselbe Prüfung muss in zwei Jahren dasselbe Ergebnis liefern.

🛠️ Du prüfst nach, was tatsächlich angekommen ist. Wenn die Charge im Lager eintrifft, kommt ein Muster daraus zu dir und wird gegen das verwahrte Freigabemuster abgeglichen. Genau hier fallen die Fälle auf, in denen etwas anderes geliefert wurde als freigegeben. Denn nicht nur die erste Lieferung muss stimmen, sondern die zwanzigste auch.

🛠️ Du prüfst über das gesamte Sortiment. Handwerkzeug vom Hammer über Schraubendreher, Zangen und Schlüssel bis zu Messwerkzeug und Schutzausrüstung. Und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör: Bohrer, Bits, Säbelsägen-, Stichsägen- und Kreissägeblätter, Schleifmittel. Handwerkzeug beurteilst du statisch, Zubehör nur unter Last — mit definiertem Prüfwerkstoff und Abbruchkriterium, damit Standzeiten vergleichbar bleiben.

🛠️ Du machst Qualität messbar. Fehlerquoten je Lieferant, Warengruppe und Charge, Reklamations- und Rückläuferquoten je Artikel, qualitätsbezogene Lieferantenbewertung. Damit im Einkauf mit Zahlen entschieden wird und nicht mit Eindrücken.

🛠️ Du gehst Kundenfehlern auf den Grund. Reklamationen, Rückläufer und Produktbewertungen sind die schnellste Qualitätsmeldung, die wir bekommen — schneller als jeder Lieferantenbericht. Du liest sie als Befund, ordnest sie der Charge zu und schließst den Kreis zum Lieferanten.

🛠️ Du steuerst unsere externen Prüfinstitute. Wo eine Norm eine akkreditierte Prüfung verlangt — VPA, TÜV, VDE — holst du Angebote, beauftragst, verfolgst Termine und bewertest die Berichte. Du behältst den Überblick, welche Norm für welche Warengruppe gilt.
🛠️ Du richtest unsere Prüfwerkstatt ein. Prüfplätze, Messmittel, Prüfwerkstoffe, Prüfmittelverwaltung mit Kalibrierintervallen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchem Equipment du arbeitest.
🛠️ Du arbeitest mit unserem QC-Officer in Asien zusammen. Er prüft vor Ort in den Werken, du bewertest seine Berichte und gibst die Prüfanforderungen vor. Zwei Kontrollpunkte, ein System.
🛠️ Es gibt eine Prüfsystematik, nach der auch jemand anderes prüfen könnte — mit Prüfvorschriften, AQL-Niveaus und Freigabemustern für die wichtigsten Warengruppen.
🛠️ Keine Sendung verlässt die Produktion ohne dokumentierte Freigabe. Und die Prüfung ist trotzdem kein Nadelöhr.
🛠️ Jeder Befund ist zu Charge, Lieferant und Produktionszeitraum zurückverfolgbar.
🛠️ Es gibt ein monatliches Qualitätsreporting, das im Einkauf tatsächlich benutzt wird.
🛠️ Reklamationen und Rückläufer sind messbar zurückgegangen, weil Fehler bei dir auffallen und nicht beim Kunden.
🛠️ Die Prüfwerkstatt steht, inklusive Verschleißprüfung unter Last.

🛠️ Technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister, oder ein technisches Studium. Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Qualitätsmanagement oder vergleichbar — die Richtung ist offener als du denkst, die Praxis zählt mehr als der Abschluss.
🛠️ Zwei bis fünf Jahre in Qualitätssicherung oder Qualitätsmanagement. Idealerweise in einem Unternehmen, das beschafft statt selbst fertigt, mit internationalen Lieferanten.
🛠️ Erstbemusterung, Prüfplanung und AQL sind für dich keine Abkürzungen, sondern Alltag. Du hast schon Erstmusterprüfberichte geschrieben und Annahmezahlen festgelegt.
🛠️ Du verstehst Werkzeug als Anwender. Du hast selbst gebohrt, gesägt und geschraubt und weißt, wie sich ein gutes Werkzeug anfühlt. Ohne das bleibt jede Beurteilung eine Zahl ohne Bedeutung.

🛠️ Reproduzierbarkeit ist dein Anspruch, nicht deine Pflicht. Du hältst fest, was du feststellst — Messwert, Bild, Bedingung, Urteil. Weil ein Befund nur dann etwas wert ist, wenn er sich in zwei Jahren noch nachvollziehen lässt.
🛠️ Du bleibst standfest. Eine Sperrung hält Ware auf, und dann wird es unbequem. Wer im Zweifel freigibt, um Ruhe zu haben, macht in dieser Rolle den teuersten Fehler.
🛠️ KI ist dein tägliches Werkzeug. Wir arbeiten damit im ganzen Unternehmen. Wenn du damit schon Auswertungen, Vorlagen oder Abläufe gebaut hast, passt du gut zu uns.
🛠️ Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Du sprichst direkt mit unseren Herstellern und liest Prüfberichte im Original.

Bonus: Erfahrung mit asiatischen Lieferanten. Erfahrung mit Messmitteln wie Messschieber, Härteprüfung oder Drehmomentprüfung. Kenntnis der Normen für Werkzeug und Elektrowerkzeug-Zubehör. Erfahrung mit Verschleiß- und Standzeitprüfungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau eines QM-Systems oder einer Prüfstelle. Und wenn du eine Prüfvorschrift oder ein Prüfkonzept mitbringst, das du selbst geschrieben hast — zeig es uns. Wir wollen sehen, wie du denkst, nicht nur was im CV steht.

🛠️ Du baust die Funktion auf, nicht nur den Prüfplatz. Prüfsystematik, Kennzahlen, Lieferantenbewertung, Prüfwerkstatt — du entscheidest, wie Qualität bei PRESCH funktioniert. Bei weiterem Wachstum wird daraus ein eigener Bereich mit Team.
🛠️ Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Kein Konzern-Reporting, keine Zwischenebene. Du berichtest direkt und bekommst Entscheidungen am selben Tag.
🛠️ Deine Freigabe hat Gewicht. Ohne dein Ja geht keine Ware raus. Das ist Verantwortung, die man nicht in jeder Qualitätsstelle bekommt.

🛠️ Gleitzeit. Du willst Job und Familie die gleiche Zeit widmen und sehnst dich daher nach einem flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodell? Kein Problem! Wir integrieren die Arbeit in unser Leben und nicht andersherum.
🛠️ Homeoffice-Tage für die Schreibtischanteile deiner Arbeit — Auswertungen, Prüfvorschriften, Reporting. Geprüft wird vor Ort, alles andere in Absprache mit dem Team.

🛠️ Du willst dich weiterentwickeln — Qualitätsmanagement, Messtechnik, Normenwissen, Auditorenqualifikation? Alles klar, dann los! Wir legen großen Wert auf deine Weiterbildung und schaffen den finanziellen und zeitlichen Rahmen dafür.

🛠️ Unsere Hierarchien sind flach, der Zusammenhalt ist groß: Wir feiern unseren Erfolg. Wissensaustausch, Glühweinabende, BBQ und regelmäßige Teamevents erwarten dich bei uns. Getränke sind selbstverständlich dabei.
🛠️ Du bist in alle Geschehnisse unseres jungen und wachsenden Unternehmens einbezogen und führst deine eigenen Projekte.
Wenn du Qualitätssicherung nicht verwalten, sondern aufbauen willst — dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for an Avionics Systems Engineer to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.

The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

System Design &
column2:
Architecture

  • Define and develop avionics system architectures, including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

  • Ensure end-to-end consistency of data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements.

  • Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

  • Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications &
column3:
Data Handling

  • Define onboard and ground-related communication and data handling concepts.

  • Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

  • Ensure reliable data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission under mission constraints.

  • Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration &
column4:
Interface Management

  • Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

  • Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

  • Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory &
column5:
Certification Leadership

Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.

Verification &
column6:
Validation

  • Define and support verification and validation strategies for avionics systems.

  • Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

  • Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

  • Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

  • Capture, analyze, and manage system and subsystem requirements.

  • Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

  • Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

  • Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with software, hardware, systems, operations, and mission engineering teams.

  • Participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, and system trade-off discussions.

  • Support alignment with external partners, suppliers, and customers.

  • Contribute to integration campaigns, launch preparation, and mission operations support.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent.

  • +7 years experience in avionics systems, electronics, embedded systems, or spacecraft engineering.

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Electronic and embedded system architectures

    • Communication and data handling principles

    • System integration and interface management

  • Experience with requirements engineering and system lifecycle development.

  • Knowledge of verification and validation methods, including testing and simulation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary engineering environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in spacecraft avionics or aerospace systems.

  • Familiarity with space communication and data standards (e.g., CCSDS).

  • Experience with HIL testing, simulation environments, or digital engineering tools.

  • Exposure to safety-critical or mission-critical system development.

  • Experience working in international or multi-stakeholder engineering teams.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Deployment Strategists are our customers' #1 go-to person

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Own the customer end-to-end together with an FDE Tech Lead. From kickoff to renewal, you are on the hook. You run SteerCos, scope deployments, drive onboarding, and decide what gets built next.

  • Scope the agents that work best for a customer You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all it’s details. You bring home whatever solves their problems and conceptualize this across all of your customers

  • Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core platform. You translate customer behavior into product feedback features and will need to be opinionated on product / our agents

  • Identify, elevate and partner with end users as well as C-Level. You support the internal owner and help scope the long term growth plan.

  • Tell the story. You speak at industry events, co-author case studies, and represent Atira in front of customer executives and prospects. The GTM motion is built around the stories you create

What we are looking for

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a team or larger project

  • 3+ Years customer facing experience working with both end users and C-Level

  • You thrive in customer-facing situations: high-stakes conversations with executives energize you, you push back when needed, and you walk out with a clear next step

  • You’ve optimized your AI tooling: you’ve invested heavily in building the skills and context layer to get the maximum out of your day

  • Relevant coding or strong analytical experience

security-engineer-identity-and-access-management-iam-milton-keynes-156931,Allica Bank,Security Engineer - Identity and Access Management (IAM),"

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Security is a hands-on, delivery-focused team that helps Allica Bank move quickly while maintaining strong, proportionate, and effective security controls.

The team combines day-to-day operational support with continuous improvement, automation, control assurance, and stakeholder partnership across the bank.

We work closely with Technology, Engineering, Product and business teams to make security practical and effective, while ensuring our controls support the requirements of a regulated banking environment.

Role Description

  • The purpose of this role is to strengthen Allica Bank's identity and access controls by making access easier to request, safer to approve and simpler to evidence. The role will combine day-to-day IAM operations with engineering, automation, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and improve the security and governance of identity services.

  • The role sits within Security and focuses on Identity and Access Management, primarily across Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Entra Identity Governance, Azure identity, access management and security controls, with support for Google Cloud Platform IAM governance, engineering and automation as that capability develops.

  • The successful candidate will contribute to the day-to-day running of IAM services, including access requests, joiner/mover/leaver activity, access reviews, privileged access, RBAC, application SSO, and application onboarding. Alongside BAU responsibilities, they will identify and deliver improvements to processes, controls, and automation.

  • This is not a purely operational IAM role. The successful candidate will be expected to run IAM services, engineer improvements, automate repeatable work, strengthen controls and help mature identity services across the bank.

  • Experience using automation and AI tools to improve processes, reduce manual effort and strengthen security controls is desirable.

  • Success in this role will be measured through the quality and timeliness of IAM operations, stronger identity governance and evidence, improved automation, and reduced manual effort.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Operate and maintain IAM services, including user lifecycle management, access requests, provisioning, deprovisioning and access changes across Microsoft Entra ID and integrated applications.

  • Manage identity governance and access controls, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), least-privilege access, Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management (PIM).

  • Manage access reviews and certifications, including reviewer engagement, evidence collection, exception handling, remediation tracking and reporting.

  • Onboard and integrate applications into the IAM/IGA platform, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM provisioning and secure authentication using Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Support application and vendor onboarding from an IAM perspective, assessing authentication, provisioning, privileged access, logging, ownership and access review requirements.

  • Maintain effective IAM controls and audit evidence, supporting internal and external audits and regulatory requirements.

  • Identify and deliver improvements through automation, improved workflows, better request processes, clearer ownership and enhanced reporting, reducing manual effort and improving control effectiveness.

  • Support identity-related issues and investigations, working with application owners, Technology, Security and other stakeholders to resolve access issues and manage associated risks.

  • Maintain IAM documentation and operational standards, including process guides, access models, onboarding standards, control evidence, and runbooks.

  • Support wider identity and cloud access services where needed, including Azure identity, access management and security controls, credential lifecycle management, and Google Cloud IAM governance, engineering and automation.

  • Provide clear reporting to Security leadership, highlighting IAM risks, control status, work in progress, blockers, and remediation actions.

  • Support related control and regulatory activities, including Risk Smart Indicators and Data Subject Access Requests, where IAM input or evidence is needed.

Personal Attributes &
column2:
Experience

  • Experience in Identity and Access Management, Security Operations, Cloud Security or technical operations, ideally within a regulated or control-focused environment.

  • Good hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Azure identity, access management and security controls, including users, groups, Enterprise Applications, SSO, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management and access management controls.

  • Understanding of IAM principles and controls, including least privilege, RBAC, privileged access, joiner/mover/leaver processes and segregation of duties.

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in London.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution.

You'll:

  • Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications.

  • Lead technically complex initiatives across areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

  • Translate ambiguous business and merchant problems into scalable, pragmatic technical solutions.

  • Drive technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term product needs.

  • Own systems and initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and design through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and engineers across teams to align on solutions and delivery.

  • Support and mentor other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance.

  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining strong judgment around correctness, security, maintainability, and quality.

  • Work comfortably outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve problems end-to-end.
