How We Work

  • Ownership: Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production.

  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas.

  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

  • Strong experience designing, building, and operating production software at scale in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments.

  • Experience owning complex features, services, or technical initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation.

  • Strong understanding of system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, observability, and production reliability.

  • Experience making technical and architectural decisions where there are multiple valid approaches and meaningful trade-offs.

  • A track record of helping other engineers grow through mentoring, technical guidance, code reviews, or knowledge sharing.

  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • You'll own significant parts of the product and ship the things customers feel most. It's a regulated platform moving money across multiple jurisdictions, so the work has to be right and it still has to be fast.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

  • Alongside that, we're rethinking how we build with AI. We use the tools, but we know there's a step change available to teams who redesign their whole workflow around them rather than adding AI to how they already work. If you've already done that somewhere else, you'll have a lot of room here.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and run non-trivial production systems, and you've learned what works in which situations rather than defaulting to one approach.

  • Strong architectural judgement. Most of our code is now written by an LLM, which means you need to own the decisions around it: how the system is structured, what the patterns are, whether the thing being built is the right thing at all. Our stack is Go, and if you learn quickly, not having written it isn't a problem.

  • A serious AI practice. You can talk specifically about how AI has changed the way you build, what it's actually made faster, and what you've shared with the teams you've worked in.

  • Directness. You give feedback when something isn't good enough and take it just as well.

  • Good instincts about what's worth doing. You know when something needs to be built properly and when it doesn't, and you push for the work that makes everyone around you faster.

Probably not for you if

You think the impact of AI on engineering is overstated. You'd rather be handed a fully specified ticket than question the brief. Or the learning curve across finance, compliance and multiple jurisdictions sounds like a chore rather than the interesting part.

The people who do well here find that last bit genuinely interesting. Understanding how capital actually moves, and what the rules allow in each jurisdiction, is most of what makes this product hard to build and hard to copy.

The hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one.

  1. Call with Imani, our Head of People and Talent. You'll get a proper picture of the role and the company, and we'll get into how you work and how you build.

  2. System design session with our engineering team. No leetcode and no take-home. We want to see how you approach a problem and structure a solution.

  3. Paid trial day. A real Odin problem with everything you need handed to you. You see how we work, we see how you ship.

column3: >Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

>Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. About the role:

column1: Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.
This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

• Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.

• Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
• Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.

  • Technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex software products well enough to translate them into operational and commercial value

  • Empathy for military users and their mission

  • EU citizenship (contractual requirement tied to our defense contracts)

  • Fluency in the local language of the market you're covering, plus English

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience at a defense tech or dual-use startup

computer-vision-engineer-paris-29942,Comand Ai,Computer Vision Engineer,"

Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments. We are fully indexed on the success of every single user, which means our research has to work in the field, not on a benchmark.

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you own the hardest perception problems in the stack. The job is to crack the scientific problems that prevent us from turning multi-source sensor data (satellite, drone, ISR, OSINT) into real-time operational clarity. Your models ship into production on short cycles, used by people for whom bad output has real consequences.

In practice:

  • Design and train architectures for object detection and segmentation on satellite and aerial imagery, and classification across complex image types

  • Drive our applied research agenda: track the state of the art rigorously, form hypotheses, iterate fast

  • Push models to production readiness: optimize for inference speed and robustness under distribution shift, which will happen in field conditions

  • Work closely with data engineers and software engineers to move work from research to production without losing what matters

  • Spend time with end users and domain experts to understand what ""good"" actually means in their context

Who We're Looking For

We want scientific depth combined with the instinct to ship. Not a publication count, but evidence of both: a GitHub and Google Scholar that tell a coherent story. A recent PhD is one path in. A more experienced researcher with a strong collaborative instinct and a track record of shipping is equally welcome.

Must-have:

  • PhD in AI, deep learning, or computer vision, or 5-10 years of serious applied research with a track record to back it up

  • Strong deep learning expertise, non-negotiable. Computer vision experience strongly preferred

  • Solid Python, Git, and PyTorch. JAX/Flax, scikit-learn, and Numpy are real pluses

  • Hands-on experience with Transformer and multimodal architectures applied to visual data

  • EU citizenship (required by our defense contracts)

  • English fluency

  • A genuine appetite for cross-functional work: you explain your technical choices, co-design with product and operational teams, and take ownership of outcomes rather than just models

Nice to have:

  • Applied work with satellite, aerial, or drone imagery

  • Experience deploying models to constrained or sovereign environments

  • SQL/PostgreSQL

  • Prior work in defense, dual-use, or operational tech

  • Geospatial data processing background

What's In It For You

  • Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity)

  • Paris-based with occasional travel to active deployment areas

The Process

  1. Talent screening: 30 min, online. We talk through your background and motivation.

  2. Research deep dive: 60 min, online. We evaluate the depth of your expertise and how you reason through hard CV and deep learning problems.

  3. Technical interview: 60 min, online. Coding and applied ML problem-solving. A second round may follow if we want more signal.

  4. Onsite in Paris: half day. Analytical decomposition then a short project presentation.

  5. Roundtable: hiring committee

About Verso

Verso is an AI-native consumer research platform. We start with AI-moderated qualitative research and are building for each client a system of consumer intelligence: every study compounds into a living understanding of their consumers that their teams, and their own AI, can draw on over time.

Lydia spent 7 years at BCG leading AI-powered transformation for consumer brands and knows the buyer's pain from the inside. Camille is an AI expert and a pioneer in agentic systems. Together they built Verso to turn consumer understanding into a real-time advantage for the brands we serve.

We are hiring our Founding GTM to build and own Verso's GTM brain: an AI-driven growth motion where outbound, inbound, and events run on tooling and automation you design, and where each play compounds instead of resetting every quarter.

  • Outbound. You build the outbound motion from scratch: target account lists, sequences, the tooling, and the messaging that gets a Head of Insights to reply. You run account-based plays into named enterprise targets and hand qualified pipeline to sales.

  • Inbound. You own the demand side: content, SEO and GEO, the website, lead magnets, and the nurture that turns a reader into a booked demo. You turn Verso's point of view on research into pipeline.

  • Events and field. Conferences, roundtables, dinners, webinars. You decide where our buyers are, get us in front of them, and run the follow-up that turns a handshake into a pilot.

  • The GTM brain. You wire AI through the whole funnel: automation, enrichment, sequencing, growth system, attribution, and the experiments that tell you which channel to scale. You decide what good looks like and make it repeatable, so the motion compounds instead of resetting.

  • Brand and narrative. You work with the founders to sharpen how Verso shows up, so a skeptical researcher meets ""rigor, not hype"" at every touchpoint.

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience in GTM, with experience building and running a full-funnel growth motion yourself.

  • You know enterprise plays. You have marketed or sold into long, multi-stakeholder cycles, run account-based motions into named accounts, and you understand how a Head of Insights or a CMO actually buys.

  • You use AI and automation to move faster, experiment more, and operate like a much larger team

  • You are data-driven. You decide what to scale from what the funnel tells you, not from what feels good.

  • Coming from the insights or research world is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is that you have built enterprise pipeline before.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

This role is for you if

  • You want to build a growth engine from the first inputs and own every channel, not inherit one.

  • You are frustrated by how slow and expensive research still is, and you want to take something genuinely different to market.

  • You like doing the work yourself, across every channel rather than one.

  • You specialise in one channel and want to stay in it.

  • You need a team and a budget in place before you can perform.

  • You take a differentiated product to a market that has mostly not seen it yet, in a category being defined right now.

This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end.

You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences.

Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions.
column4:

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership.

• Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business

• Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building.

• Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit.

• Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought.

• Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it.

• Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact.

• Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners.

• Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it.

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que le Design est un accélérateur de croissance responsable pour les entreprises.
Mais pour avoir un réel impact, le rôle du designer doit évoluer.
Nous défendons une approche de Product Designers “Product Builders”, capables de maîtriser l’ensemble du cycle produit : de la discovery à la delivery, en collaboration étroite avec le Produit, la Tech et le Business.

Des designers augmentés par la data et l’IA, qui leur permettent d’explorer plus vite, décider avec justesse et délivrer avec impact.

Le Product Design doit donc être porté à un niveau stratégique pour transformer réellement les organisations.

Nous recherchons des expert.e.s qui incarnent cette vision.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

You will own the systems that power our cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on role. You spend the majority of your time in the code, in architecture decisions, and in the hardest technical problems the team faces. The rest you spend leading a small squad of engineers and partnering with Product Managers to ship what customers depend on.

You design the architecture. You write the code. You make the technical calls. Then you clear the path for your engineers to do their best work and push past what they thought they could do. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

This is a role for an engineer who leads from the front because that is where the work is, not because management was the next rung on the ladder.

What You Will Do

  • Design and ship the systems. You write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions, not just the roadmap that tracks them.

  • Run Kubernetes in production and understand the layers beneath it. You make the calls when the platform breaks at 3am and your engineers learn from how you do it.

  • Own delivery of your team's roadmap. Projects ship with the reliability and performance that finance, healthcare, and public-sector workloads demand.

  • Build engineers, not just software. You set the standard for ownership, remove the obstacles in their way, and push them past their comfort zone until the work they ship surprises them.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs. You translate between what customers need and what the platform has to become.

  • Define the team's processes and execution rituals. Keep the path clear as the team and the platform scale toward a gigawatt of capacity.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentoring, and knowledge sharing. The team you build here sets the technical standard for the whole Cloud Platform org.

What We're Looking For

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You have run Kubernetes in anger and understand what happens underneath it. You have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

  • You are T-shaped: deep in one area (storage, networking, or observability preferred), conversant across the rest of the stack. We are building new teams in each of these areas and want leads who can help stand them up.

  • You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code that other engineers depend on.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

senior-devops-engineer-all-genders-berlin-413735,Sunday Natural,Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders),"

Sunday Natural is one of Germany’s fastest-growing natural health brands, and our eCommerce platform is growing with it – today it serves 7 million monthly active users, runs on €400k of AWS per year, and supports a development organization of 30+ engineers. Every one of those numbers has moved sharply upward in the last few years, and all of them will keep moving.

You would be our first dedicated in-house Senior DevOps Engineer – and the two biggest engineering projects of the next two years are yours to help define and drive: bringing our entire infrastructure under Terraform, and strengthening the scalability, security and compliance posture across our cloud environments.

Your role

  • You shape the infrastructure vision. How we run, deploy, monitor and scale is yours to define, propose and defend.

  • You work alongside our two external partners as the in-house technical counterpart – building the architecture and standards together, and bringing the deep platform knowledge back into the company. As the platform grows, taking the technical direction of that group is a natural next step, and one we would actively support.

  • You own our AWS spend – €400k a year that currently has no dedicated owner, including where it goes and how we bring it down.

  • You are the escalation point. When production is at risk, you decide.

  • You report directly to the Head of eCommerce Platforms, with direct access to leadership for the decisions that need it.

What you'll own

  • AWS infrastructure – EC2, RDS, Fargate, CloudFront, S3, IAM – plus Cloudflare, DNS and WAF

  • Security &
column2:
compliance – DevSecOps practices, system audits, patching and access reviews, and GDPR-compliant data handling across every environment

  • Infrastructure as code – taking us from manually managed to fully Terraform-defined

  • Data layer – MySQL under production load: tuning, replication, and backups you have actually restored from

  • Cloud economics – a €350k annual AWS budget with real headroom for optimisation

  • Delivery for 30+ developers – Bitbucket Pipelines, environments, and how fast and safely code reaches production

  • Reliability at 7M MAU – monitoring, logging, alerting and incident response (New Relic, Sentry, CloudWatch, PagerDuty)

    • Your profile

    • 7+ years running production infrastructure, with deep hands-on AWS as the person accountable when it breaks

    • Security-conscious infrastructure operations – DevSecOps practices, system audits and access reviews, comfortable being accountable for GDPR-relevant data handling

    • Infrastructure as code at scale – Terraform as your default way of working, on an estate of comparable size

    • Deep Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) – you can trace a slow system from the kernel up and explain what you found

    • MySQL under real load – slow-query analysis, replication, indexing, tested recovery

    • Ownership of monitoring and incident response at scale – you have built the alerting that catches problems before customers report them, using tooling like New Relic, Datatog, etc. and run the on-call and post-incident process around it

    • Experience defining standards that other engineers work to, whether with in-house teams or external partners, and holding the line on them

    Nice to have

    • PHP-FPM / Magento 2 performance tuning, or Varnish and Redis at scale

    • Cloud cost optimisation at six-figure annual spend

    • AWS architecture certification

    • Experience with SIEM tooling (e.g. Wazuh) or similar security monitoring

    • Background in direct-to-consumer eCommerce or other high-traffic system operations

    Our stack

    Magento 2 · PIM · PHP · MySQL · Redis · Varnish · Docker · AWS · Terraform · Bitbucket Pipelines · New Relic · Sentry · CloudWatch · PagerDuty · Cloudflare

    What we offer

    • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins &
column3:

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea &
column4:
office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

We are looking forward to your application!

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

fullstack-engineer-prospect-ui-solutions-munich-415043,Constructor,FullStack Engineer - Prospect UI Solutions,"

About You

You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About the Position

As a Software Engineer on the Prospect UI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how Constructor will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

In this role, you will:

  • Fuel our proprietary AI models: Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software
column2:
building solutions that you are proud to call your own

  • Seal the deal: Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands.

  • Leverage your tech knowledge: Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations.

  • Deliver excellence: Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services.

  • Empower a sales force: Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team.

  • Be a part of the answer: Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services.

  • Elevate the team: Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions.

  • Visualize brilliance: Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch.

  • Innovate with purpose: Implement and test new features for our open-source JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients.

  • Collaborative contribution: Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success.

  • Champion team culture: Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth, and support for others.

    • This role is ideal for any Software Engineer passionate about search technology, customer-focused solutions, and collaborative development.

    • A minimum of four years of professional experience or relevant academic experience

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

    • English on C1 level (CEFR) or higher

    • Strong foundation and experience with server-side and client-side programming languages

    • Enjoys interacting with customers and solving new problems daily

    • Able to pick up new technologies and design patterns quickly and loves learning them

    • Experience with building User Interfaces utilizing front-end frameworks like (but not limited to) React, Vue or Angular

    • Proven track record of building UIs with heavy consideration for friendly user experience

    • Experience with automated tests like (but not limited to) Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library

    • Experience in JavaScript will be a strong asset for this role, but candidates with a proven Software Development background that demonstrate a willingness to quickly learn the language will also be considered

    • Nice to have - TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Storybook, Python and web scraping experience

    • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

    • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

    • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

    • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

    • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

    • 👪 Maternity &

Analyst Early Stage Investment Team (m/f/d) - Berlin, Munich, London

HV Capital is one of Europe's largest generalist VCs. We invest from pre-seed through growth, across SaaS, fintech, deep tech, and beyond. This is a seat inside the investment team, working directly with partners on sourcing, diligence, and portfolio support.

What you'll actually work on

Finding the next companies before anyone else does. Building market maps in sectors we're excited about, sourcing directly instead of waiting for inbound, running comps, and going deep enough on a space that you know it better than the partner sitting next to you.

Running real diligence. Talking to founders, customers, and competitors. Building the model, not just filling in someone else's template. Stress-testing a business case instead of taking the deck at face value. Writing memos that make a case a partner would actually defend in an investment committee.

Forming your own view, and holding it. We're still making bets on people as much as products, and that means judgment: reading a founder, reading a room, deciding whether you'd trust this person with your own money. That's a muscle, not a checklist.

Sitting in the room, eventually. Partner meetings and deal reviews once you've earned it
column2:
not to run them, but to watch how a real investment decision actually gets made, and to have a sharp, well-formed view ready when someone asks for yours.

Portfolio support. The odd KPI request, board-prep question, or research ask from a founder who needs a sharp answer fast, not a polished deck in two weeks.

What good looks like here

We evaluate analysts on judgment and reasoning (can you form an independent view and defend it under pushback), commercial acumen (do you actually understand what makes a business work), deal execution (can you run a process end to end from sourcing, modeling, diligence to closing support), and how you show up in the room. The craft still matters. A clean model, a memo that holds up, a process run properly. That's the baseline, not optional. What increasingly separates a good analyst from a great one on top of that is judgment: forming a view nobody handed you, and holding it under pushback.

What we're looking for

At least 2 -3 years of real work experience. Beyond that, we don't have one template. We've hired from strategy consulting, banking, asset management, the sciences, and straight out of operating roles at startups. You are the architect and builder of the customer-facing side of the LEASETEQ platform in Berlin, and the owner of our German market on it.   • Own the German market on our customer-facing platform: credit and compliance requirements, dealer flows, German copy, and the acceptance criteria that make them verifiable
  • Design and build the digital application journey — multi-step forms, validation, resumable state, document upload, KYC steps and the unhappy paths users actually hit

  • Write the use-case and API layers behind the journey to our clean-architecture standard — this is a full-stack role, not a UI role

  • Author specification-driven change proposals, and act as the named human approver for journey and mapping changes in the German market
  • Grow end-to-end test coverage on the critical journeys: coverage is what licenses autonomous agent work in a module
  • Work with our Berlin backend team on the seam between the orchestration core and the customer-facing platform, and with our Jakarta platform engineers who own the journey across all three markets

  • Fintech experience is mandatory: production work on a regulated financial product — leasing, lending, banking, payments or insurance — where money moved and a regulator could ask why
  • Proven ownership of a complex multi-step onboarding or application flow is mandatory: validation strategy, partial persistence and resumption, conditional branching by market or product, document upload
  • Real backend capability: use cases, repository implementations, API handlers and PostgreSQL / Prisma queries — roughly a 60/40 split toward the frontend, not 90/10

worldwideAbout LEASETEQ
LEASETEQ builds the orchestration brain for mid-market car leasing and asset finance in the DACH region. Our platform automates the full contract lifecycle – from origination and credit decision through to end-of-term – using Flowable BPM as the core process engine on a modern, event-driven micro-services architecture, with a Next.js / TypeScript platform serving our customer, dealer and operations portals in four languages across Switzerland, Germany and Austria.

Build brand communities on social media


Introduction

You don't just manage social media, you shape how brands show up on it. You know what's about to peak on TikTok before it peaks, and you're as strong creatively as you are strategically, ideating concepts in a client workshop and owning their execution the next day. column2:
>

Bei Yalwa ist es unsere Mission, Leute zusammenzubringen. Wir streben danach, die digitale Welt zu einem Ort zu machen, an dem Menschen echte Beziehungen zueinander aufbauen können. Bei Yalwa zu arbeiten bedeutet, Teil eines freundlichen, passionierten Teams von Mitarbeitenden aus über 25 verschiedenen Ländern zu sein. Mit der Unterstützung deiner Kollegen*innen hast du die Möglichkeit dich selbst herauszufordern, dich weiterzuentwickeln, dein Wissen zu teilen, deine Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und an ambitionierten Projekten zu arbeiten.

Bist du empathisch, organisationsstark und begeistert von moderner Personalarbeit sowie dem Umgang mit Menschen? Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudierenden im Bereich HR und Personal, der unser Team verstärkt, eine erstklassige Employee Journey mitgestaltet und unser Tagesgeschäft tatkräftig unterstützt.
column3:
>

Deine Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung unseres HR-Teams bei der Beantwortung allgemeiner Anfragen unserer Mitarbeitenden

  • Mitarbeit im Recruiting-Prozess, beispielsweise bei der Erstellung von Stellenausschreibungen, der Terminkoordination von Vorstellungsgesprächen und der ersten Sichtung von Bewerbungsunterlagen

  • Begleitung der Employee Journey vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt mit organisatorischer Vorbereitung und Begleitung des Onboardings neuer Teammitglieder

  • Zuarbeit im operativen Tagesgeschäft, unter anderem bei der Stammdatenpflege in Personio, der Verwaltung digitaler Personalakten, der Betreuung unseres Abwesenheits-Tools und der Erstellung von Arbeits- sowie Zwischenzeugnissen

  • Studium der Fachrichtungen Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL / WiWi) mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Psychologie, Sozialwissenschaften, Pädagogik oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin, idealerweise bereits im Masterstudium

  • Praxiserfahrung im HR-Bereich oder Recruiting durch vorherige Praktika oder Nebenjobs als schätzenswertes Plus

  • Persönlichkeit geprägt von Empathie, hoher Sozialkompetenz, ausgeprägter Kommunikationsstärke, Teamgeist und Flexibilität

  • Sprachkenntnisse auf fließendem Niveau in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift
column4:

  • Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre in top modernen Büros

  • Hybrides, flexibles Arbeitsmodell

  • Tolles Team und Spaß an der Arbeit

  • Einen leistungsstarken Arbeitgeber mit über 20-jähriger Erfolgsgeschichte

  • Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsmöglichkeiten

  • Gesundheitsförderung, EGYM Wellpass, Deutschlandticket, Massagen, Zuschüsse zur Vorsorge, Mittagessen, MacBook Pro und vieles mehr
column5:

Dabei stehst du nicht vor einer fertigen Landschaft: Die Migration von VMware auf Proxmox VE ist beschlossen und startet gerade — du begleitest sie mit und übernimmst danach den operativen Betrieb des Clusters. Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

  • Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

  • Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

  • Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

  • A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Bei HWS verbinden wir Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung mit dem Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen nicht nur fachlich exzellent, sondern auch zukunftsfähig zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir eine eigene KI-Plattform mit spezialisierten KI-Agenten und Skills, die unsere Teams im Kanzleialltag konkret unterstützen – etwa bei der Aufbereitung von Daten, der Qualitätssicherung, der Recherche und der Erstellung strukturierter Arbeitsergebnisse.
Dafür suchen wir Sie: neugierig, technisch versiert und mit Freude daran, aus guten Ideen hilfreiche KI-Anwendungen zu entwickeln – gerne auch vollständig remote. 


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie konzipieren, entwickeln und optimieren KI-Agenten und spezialisierte Skills für interne Arbeitsabläufe. 
  • Sie übersetzen Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung und Unternehmensberatung in klare und robuste KI-Workflows. 
  • Sie formulieren und optimieren Prompts, Entscheidungslogiken und strukturierte Fragebögen. 
  • Sie testen Ergebnisse systematisch, erkennen Fehlerbilder und entwickeln unsere Qualitätsstandards weiter. 
  • Sie unterstützen bei der Anbindung und Nutzung von Datenquellen und Tools, beispielsweise DATEV-Exporte, Tabellen, Dokumente oder interne Wissensbestände. 
  • Sie dokumentieren Lösungen verständlich und sorgen dafür, dass Kolleginnen und Kollegen diese sicher anwenden können. 
  • Sie verfolgen neue Entwicklungen rund um KI-Agenten, Large Language Models und Automatisierung und bringen geeignete Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. 
Für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung Ihrer Ideen erhalten Sie Zugriff auf gängige KI- und Coding-Tools wie Claude und Codex.


Ihr Profil

  • Sie studieren Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Digital- oder Technologieschwerpunkt oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. 
  • Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für künstliche Intelligenz, insbesondere für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering oder agentische Workflows. 
  • Idealerweise bringen Sie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung oder Vibe Coding mit. 
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, denken analytisch und geben sich nicht mit einer Antwort zufrieden, nur weil diese überzeugend klingt. 
  • Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen. 
  • Vorkenntnisse in der Steuerberatung, im Rechnungswesen oder im Umgang mit DATEV sind willkommen, aber kein Muss – Ihr Interesse und Ihre Lernbereitschaft zählen. 
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab. 


Warum wir?

  • Flexibel bleiben: Arbeitszeiten, die zu Studium, Alltag und Leben passen.

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world's candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves, reformulated with less sugar and zero compromise on taste. We are 120 people strong, with 170+ SKUs and aggressive growth across D2C, retail, Amazon, and new European markets.

Our Brand Activation department is where we move from product to culture. We do that through limited editions: co-branded drops with entertainment IPs, licensing deals with cultural icons, collaborations that make people genuinely excited about what they are eating.

Are you a senior brand partnerships and licensing professional who closes deals, owns projects end-to-end, and has the network to make things happen from day one? If so, read on.


YOUR TASKS

  • Partner Identification &
column2:

  • Deal Negotiation &
column3:

  • End-to-End Project Management: You own the full lifecycle of every limited edition. Concept, LOI, product development, packaging redesign, legal sign-off, market launch. column4:

column5:

column2:
>Warum mute-labs?

Bei mute-labs gibt es weder „VC-getriebenen Burnout“ noch toxische Sales Floors. Wir sind ein eigenfinanziertes, nachhaltig profitables Team mit einer klaren Mission: mehr Ruhe in die lautesten Büros der Welt zu bringen.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren hochwertige Akustikboxen, die wirklich zu modernen Arbeitswelten passen.

Dabei verkaufen wir nicht einfach nur „Boxen“ – wir verkaufen Fokus, Produktivität und ein besseres Arbeitsumfeld.

Für den DACH-Markt suchen wir einen Full-Cycle BDR, der den gesamten Sales-Prozess selbst in die Hand nehmen möchte – vom ersten „Hallo“ bis zum finalen Handshake.
column3:
>Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren

Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.

  • Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
  • Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
  • Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
column4:
>So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen

Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur. Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.

  • 09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
  • 09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
  • 11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
  • 12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
  • 14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
  • 18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.
column6:
Pints Friday

Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.

  • The Pulse: In unserem Team-Huddle schauen wir auf die Zahlen, teilen Company Updates und feiern Kolleg:innen, die in dieser Woche besonders viel bewegt haben.
  • The Pints: Danach starten wir gemeinsam ins Wochenende – mit Drinks, alkoholisch oder 0,0 %, und dem guten Gefühl, gemeinsam etwas erreicht zu haben.
column8:
transparent

  1. The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia, um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.
  2. The Market Fit: Ein Deep Dive mit Alvaro (Country Manager) und Jarno (Sales Director), bei dem es um Deine Sales-DNA geht.
  3. The Commercial View: Ein Gespräch mit Leah (Head of Commercial) über unsere Wachstumsstrategie und Deine Rolle darin.
  4. The Live Action: Ein Discovery Role Play mit dem Team. Keine Hausaufgabe, keine tagelange Vorbereitung – wir möchten einfach sehen, wie Du ein echtes Kundengespräch führst.
  5. The Vision: Ein finales Gespräch mit unserem CEO, in dem es um das große Ganze und Deine Entwicklung bei mute-labs geht.
column9:

  • Self-Driven Hunter: Du brauchst keinen Provisionscheck, um ambitioniert zu bleiben. Du willst Deine Ziele erreichen und das Unternehmen aktiv mit voranbringen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 ""Tolles Team"" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

Company Description

Solactive AG is a FinTech company operating globally and growing at a fast pace, headquartered in Frankfurt. Since 2007, we develop tailor-made and multi-asset class index solutions for ETFs and other index-linked investment products for the leading global investment banks and asset managers as our clients. Flexibility, efficiency, and providing the highest quality are at the heart and soul of our business philosophy. We are now hiring!


Job Overview

Our Market Data team forms an essential link between our business and infrastructure teams: it defines and implements business processes in data pipelines, monitors existing services, and thereby provides the best service to our customers. As a Senior Software Developer in our Market Data team, you will be working on a broad set of real-world problems. Highly effective data management, resilience, and fail-over strategies are some of our most important topics. In close collaboration with our business analysts and data engineers, you will create high-performance data processing solutions that scale using emerging technologies and approaches and help us define new best practices. 

Our continuous business growth and high requirements on accuracy, performance, and availability will provide you with a lot of engineering challenges and opportunities to contribute, to learn, and to grow as part of our team.   

You love solving complex problems, building performant, scalable, low latency, and highly available services. Then we can’t wait to meet you!


Your Tasks

  • Designing and implementing challenging projects to develop our data processing pipeline.
  • Building up a data landscape that acts as the single source of all relevant data in the long run.
  • Engineering ETL processes.
  • Developing high performance APIs and streaming solutions to our clients and data vendors.
  • Being an in-house consultant for best track, store, and access data.


Your Profile

  • 8+ years of software development, data engineering, or relevant experience, including at least 5 years of in-depth Python experience.
  • Software Engineering: good understanding of microservice architectures, Liskov’s Substitution Principle, design patterns, and dynamic dispatch.
  • Databases: experience with at least one SQL/NoSQL database, such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, including schema definition and evolution, as well as ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy, JPA, or Hibernate.
  • Cloud / Cloud-native development: Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • CI/CD: ability to define build pipelines and perform, validate, and monitor deployments.
  • Good understanding of microservice architectures.
  • Ability to define Docker images according to the Twelve-Factor App methodology.
  • Git: ability to use Git from the command line and apply version-control management practices (e.g., Gitflow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong technical mentoring skills.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Communication: ability to illustrate ideas and concepts with figurative examples to both stakeholders and developers.
  • Ability to perceive the business domain in terms of mathematical structures is appreciated.


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family, a motivated team with an international setting.
  • Get to know the dynamics of an established, successful FinTech company.
  • Free choice of your gears to work comfortably and effectively.
  • Experience a modern start-up culture with a flat hierarchy.
  • Seize the opportunity to develop personally, take over responsibility and maintain direct customer contact from day one.
  • Flexible work environment with a hybrid work model and 30 annual vacation days.
  • Receive numerous benefits (e.g. Regular staff parties, team events, access to Corporate Benefits, modern office space, activity room, free beverages and fruit baskets).

applied-operations-research-engineer-berlin-227233,Circonomit,Applied Operations Research Engineer,"

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to ""what should we do?"" before the decision is made. Our engine turns that model into one artifact that both evaluates like a spreadsheet and optimizes like a solver. It sits between two worlds: the mathematics that makes the answer correct, and the product that has to make it usable by people who are not mathematicians.

That bridge is your mission. You work with our math and OR team to translate real customer problems into models, and you develop the engine that runs them.

We will not sugarcoat it: combinatorial search is unpredictable, customer data arrives messy, and some weeks a deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • Customer models, end to end.
column2:
Turn a planning problem, with its capacities, costs, lead times and shift plans, into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. That includes the data it runs on: ERP and Excel exports, and catching the numbers that cannot be right before the customer does.
  • The interface between software and mathematics.
column3:
Our engineers, and eventually our customers, build and extend models without needing us in the room. That means deciding where the abstraction belongs and what the modeling vocabulary has to cover, then building it and keeping it standing.
  • Answers people can act on.
column4:
A planner watches the number improve, can defend it in a meeting weeks later, and still gets something usable when the honest answer is ""impossible"": which rules collide, and what it would cost to bend one.
  • Scale in both directions.
column5:
A model that answers for one site still answers when it covers twelve, over more periods, against harder constraints. And a hundred customers solving at once, none of them noticing each other. How you get there is your call.
  • Your features from first line to production.
column6:
Nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

How we work

Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your work end to end: you build it, you ship it to production yourself, you run it.

Feedback runs both ways and continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals, communicate proactively, and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.

We review each other's work, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room. Modeling and engine work sit in the same person here by design.

Requirements

  • You have modeled and shipped combinatorial optimization in industry (MILP, CP, or both), with models that survived messy data, deadlines and real users.
  • Algorithm design you have actually shipped: you know where methods and solvers reach their limits, CP-SAT and Gurobi included, and you can say which technique bought you what, from warm starts and rolling horizon to relax-and-fix, aggregation, matheuristics, or a plain heuristic when an exact solve is the wrong tool.
  • You have run optimization workloads where someone was waiting on the answer, not only in notebooks: cancellation, timeouts and parallel solves are problems you have already solved once.
  • Python at production quality: tests, types, review, and a profiler before an optimizer. You know how numerics go wrong where a model meets a solver: scaling, tolerances, integrality, and the moment money stops fitting in an integer.
  • You want to understand the customer's problem and their data, not only the model.
  • You have worked in a team, not mostly alone.
  • German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German

ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

About the role

Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend.

This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about.

The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do.

We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment.

  • Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code.

  • Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling.

  • Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data.

  • Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

  • Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state.

  • Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications.

  • High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness.

  • A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model.

Tech stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Python

  • Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services

  • Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging

  • Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics

  • AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them

What we offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience improving leadership productivity through AI-enabled tools and efficient operating rhythms.


Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

We could tell you about the free breakfast, the drinks in the fridge, and the 30 vacation days. Or that flexible hours and remote work are part of the deal. But honestly? That's just standard.
Here's what makes working with us in Frankfurt extra special:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere - Take your job with you on a workation and get inspired by new places.
  • Time for growth - A career framework to support your professional and personal growth with up to 6 extra days off per year for your development.
  • Social Day - One paid day per year to give back: volunteer, support a cause, or attend an environmental event.
  • Bike leasing - Stay fit and sustainable. We'll handle the contract and insurance.
  • Pick your perk - Choose the benefit that fits your life best: fitness membership, public transport pass, retirement plan, or a monthly bonus.
  • Dog Friendly Office - Bring your furry coworker along. Just make sure they don't steal anyone's lunch.
Hybrid work is a natural part of how we operate, but we also believe in the power of coming together. That's why we regularly connect in the office whenever it makes sense. And that's just the beginning. Ask us what else is waiting for you!

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift.
